method: 360 full finish/readback software renders, 960x640 DPR1, 3 profiles × 4 scenes × 3 alternating rounds × 5 samples × 2 versions; exact absolute cameras and full climate including wind phase asserted per pair. 24 additional forced-shadow refresh renders. No concurrent browser/GPU work. Local startup observations n=1; logical WebGL allocation probe plus post-GC JS heap, not physical VRAM. Color-only calls/triangles and separate shadow pass metrics retained.
